overview: Kisan Seva is a luxury India-first digital farm management PWA for Indian farmers, supporting land records, crop planning, family access management, income classification, and government scheme tracking.
features: Install as PWA on Android with offline support
Farm creation with unique KS Farm ID and Indian location cascade
Family onboarding with invite links, WhatsApp sharing, and role-based access
Telugu, Hindi, and English language switching with Indian script fonts
Field management with state-adaptive land records (Adangal, Pahani, 7/12)
Crop season planning with MSP badge, stage tracker, and harvest log
Income auto-classification with 40+ Indian tax codes
Demo farm (Develvyn Farm) accessible without account
